hypothesis: HS300 stocks that absorb market information with a lag may earn a price-delay premium; combining high price delay with defensive quality and cash quality can improve returns without worsening drawdown.

factor.formula: b1 / (abs(b0) + abs(b1) + 1e-6), where b0 is the 60-return rolling beta of stock_ret on contemporaneous HS300_ret and b1 is the rolling beta of stock_ret on one-day-lagged HS300_ret
factor.returns: daily close-to-close total-return proxy using adjusted close from kline_daily_enriched; HS300 uses 000300.SH close from kline_index_daily
factor.direction: higher is better (more delayed market-information absorption)
factor.point_in_time: signal date t uses returns through close t and market return t-1; execution remains T+1 open

control_strategy.purpose: Matched universe and execution; price delay is an availability filter only, not a score component.

execution.universe: historical HS300 membership; monthly snapshots for 2018-2020 and daily snapshots from 2021

samples.recent_12m: last 252 trading-day returns of the stitched 2018-2026 curve
samples.rolling_1y: 252-trading-day rolling compounded return over the stitched 2018-2026 curve

gates.D1: factor coverage within historical HS300 membership over 2018-2026 is at least 90%
gates.D2: factor has at least 60 return observations before its first valid value and recent-12m factor coverage is at least 95%
gates.G1: independent 2018-2020 total return is at least control + 5pp
gates.G2: independent 2018-2020 MDD is no worse than control by more than 2pp
gates.G3: validation 2021-2024 total return is at least control - 5pp
gates.G4: full-sample rolling-1y positive rate is at least control
gates.G5: full-sample MDD is no worse than control by more than 2pp
gates.G6: full-sample total return is at least control - 5pp
gates.G7: recent 12m total return is positive and recent 12m MDD is no worse than control by more than 2pp

decision_rule: All D and G gates must pass. Thresholds may not be relaxed after results. Any failed gate means the candidate remains research-only and is not a deployable factor.
known_limitations: The lagged-beta ratio is a transparent one-lag approximation to price delay, not a multivariate regression with five market lags.
Adjusted-close history is the local enriched proxy for total return.
2018-2020 HS300 membership uses monthly snapshots, so intra-month index changes are not modeled.
The factor is cross-sectional only; no separate industry or size neutralization.
